Live-verified against testmember@gmail.com: seeded a paid upcoming class booking directly in Mongo (class cls_a38f3d888984 Muay Thai / Coach Alex / 45 min / cap 16) and confirmed the enriched response returned trainer='Coach Alex', duration_min=45, capacity=16, booked=3, spots_left=13, child_name='TEST_Kiddo', child_age=9. The 3rd pytest test skipped only because there is NO admin endpoint to create a member's booking (server.py only exposes admin GET/confirm/accept/cancel/reschedule/attendance/refund on /admin/bookings/*, no POST /admin/bookings — this is expected, not a regression). The seeded paid card at top shows: (a) 'NEXT UP' orange ribbon with 'Starts in 22 hrs' countdown on the right — EXACTLY ONE ribbon on the whole list (verified by regex count = 1); (b) an orange 1.5px accent border around the entire card; (c) chip row with 'TEST_Kiddo · 9y' child chip, 'Coach Alex · 45 min' coach+duration chip, and '3 going' green spots-left chip; (d) NO redundant countdown chip inside the meta row because the NEXT UP ribbon already shows it (matches the `!isNext` guard in the chips block). Cancelled cards below correctly show child+coach chips but NO spots-left chip (correct — spots chip is gated to paid/confirmed). Confirmed free-trial bookings further down show '2 going' spots chip. GROUP CHAT (/group/grp_muaythai_academy): (e) all 3 online roster avatars render the green dot at bottom-right FULLY VISIBLE — no clipping (computed style overflow='visible' on every rosterAvatar; dots at exact border with background rgb(34,197,94), fully round 10x10); (f) tapping the pinned message bar [data-testid=group-pinned-jump] fires jumpToPinned and applies the brandTertiary (rgba(255,122,0,0.15)) highlight to the row containing 'TEST_ msg #1' (confirmed via computed backgroundColor query post-tap); scroll ref call is issued (scrollToEnd baseline moves list bottom, then jumpToPinned scrolls to the message y position with animation).
action_items: OPTIONAL polish (not a bug): active/confirmed upcoming bookings are ordered by created_at DESC in the backend (/api/bookings sort), which means older cancelled bookings can appear above a newer confirmed one. On the My Bookings screen this pushed the two Aug-17 CONFIRMED free-trial bookings to the bottom of the list under 5 CANCELLED rows for the same class. Consider sorting active/upcoming ahead of cancelled (or at least ahead of cleared/past ones) in the frontend render — NOT a regression from this PR, existed before.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _enrich_bookings (lines 2127-2158) correctly (a) attaches booking_no on every row before any early-return, (b) short-circuits when there are no class_ids, (c) aggregates live 'booked' counts only from status ∈ {paid,confirmed} (matches the ChIP visibility gate in bookings.tsx line 401), (d) gates capacity/booked/spots_left to non-by_appointment classes so PT/Program appointments don't render nonsensical 'spots left' chips.

bookings.tsx nextUpId memo (lines 74-86) is correct: filters status to paid|confirmed only, drops appointments without requested_at, drops classes without class_start, drops any session whose start is <=now, picks min ms. Verified UI shows exactly one 'NEXT UP' ribbon.

bookings.tsx meta chips (lines 375-414) correctly (a) hide the countdown chip when this card is the NEXT UP one (already on ribbon), (b) show child name+age chip only when child_name present, (c) show trainer/duration chip when either is present, (d) gate spots-left chip to !by_appointment && status in paid|confirmed. Color logic: red for full, amber for ≤3, green otherwise.

group/[id].tsx line 275 renders the online dot inside a rosterAvatar container that (styles line 476) has NO overflow:hidden — verified via getComputedStyle: overflow='visible'. Dot styled at right:-1, bottom:-1, 10x10, green fill, borderColor=surface (dark) — a clean protruding badge.

group/[id].tsx jumpToPinned (lines 122-130) uses ScrollView.scrollTo with animated:true and sets highlightId with a 1600ms auto-clear timer. onLayout at line 319 captures each row's y offset into rowYs.current. group-pinned-jump testID is present at line 296 as required.
